newsitem.title: CANADA: Atlanta Gold, Voisey Bay join forces.
newsitem.headline: Atlanta Gold, Voisey Bay join forces.

text.p: Atlanta Gold Corp and Voisey Bay Resources Inc said Monday they have entered into a joint venture to acquire, explore and develop nine mining properties in Indonesia.
The joint venture, between Atlanta, Voisey Bay and Indotan Inc of Hamilton, Bermuda, will focus on properties measuring a total of 220,000 hectares on the island of Kalimantan.
Under the deal, Atlanta and Voisey Bay will cover all costs for work contracts and property maintenance.
The properties are a major acquisition designed to advance the Indonesian activity of the two companies, they said.
